ruleName: Ball Deflected by Person Attending or Holding Up Flagstick or Anything Else
title: Replacing the Flag during a Putt in Match Play
question: In match play, Rachel deliberately replaces the flagstick in the hole while Mark is putting. Mark’s putt is then deflected by the flagstick. What is the ruling?
explanation: Under Rule 11.8, in match play, if a player deliberately takes an action to affect a ball in motion (for example, replacing the flagstick while an opponent’s ball is rolling towards the hole), they lose the hole.
